BETAFORM / RECORDING REFERENCE

Rebuild The canvas.

The original cream panel, orange Meander and blue Blue current. 22 holds + one shared volume.

The empty wall is ready

The canvas has been restored without holds in your saved Chrome session. Use Resume saved session after reloading.

Build directly from an existing panel

Open Build / edit walls, select a panel and click a green exposed edge or its +. Choose Rectangle or Triangle; the new piece is attached at that edge. Set its depth in the small on-wall menu. Use Move to drag a separate panel; joined panels keep their connections. Use Undo for any preview edit.

Original canvas dimensions (reference)

  1. Open Set a route → Build / edit walls → Start from a wall preset.
  2. Choose Straight wall, width 4, height 4.632493928760188. Click Add preset to this gym.
  3. Name it The canvas. Set Surface colour to #e5e1d5.
  4. Choose the bottom hinge (Edge 1). Enter exact inclination 13.736268305622573 and click Set angle.
  5. Expand Panel position: X 0, Y 0.32, Z -4.7. Click Move panel.
  6. Click Join matching open edges, then Apply wall design.

Height above is measured along the face. Vertical rise is 4.5 m; the top projects forward 1.1 m. Bottom corners: (−2, 0.32, −4.7), (2, 0.32, −4.7). Top corners: (−2, 4.82, −3.6), (2, 4.82, −3.6).

2. Set the routes

Select The canvas. Choose the route colour, then choose each named shape in Explore the collection. Place it on a free area, select it, and expand Exact placement. Enter the table values and click Apply placement. Add in table order, feet first. Use the Start or Finish buttons for the marked holds.

X is measured from the panel centre: negative = left. Y runs up the face from its bottom edge. All positions use the 20 cm bolt grid. Rotations are rounded to 0.0001°. Feet use the same coloured hold collection.

3. Add the shared volume

Add a volume → Traverse. Position X 0, Y 2.2, size 0.5, rotation 0, exact colour #687675. No Start or Finish marker.

Recording tip

Record the wall appearing, its angle adjustment, then a few hold placements and the completed routes. You can cut out the repeated numerical entry. Save session when your rebuilt wall is finished.
